migrationNotes: Issue #2493. Added 24 Nov 2026: per-cohort totals can point to one guest's orientation on a small event, and organisers read events, so cohortCounts, waitlistedCohortCounts and crossPathsPairHeldCohortCounts moved here. A map not moved yet falls back to the event's copy; tool/data/move_event_cohort_counts.mjs moves the rest.

newCollectionRationale.whyNotAnExistingCollection: Per-cohort totals can point to one guest's sexual orientation on a small event, so no client and no organiser may read them. events/{eventId}, where they lived, is readable by the organiser's managers and staff, rules cannot hide one field of it, and eventSeatLedgers is the seat authority with its own revisioned shape.
